SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Avoiding all community work

2. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   B. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.
   C. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   D. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.

6. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The School as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing The School.
   C. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   C. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.

8. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.
   C. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   B. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.

10. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.
   C. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   C. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   D. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   D. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Physical features in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Seasons in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
